title: Two-tag Praxis with amortized mask evaluation and exact scalar costs
claims: params.json is a parameter set of Praxis for the reference statement at 100-bit security whose ciphertext is 5548 MiB (5.4179 GiB) and whose time, one encryption plus one expected decryption, is 25037 million field multiplications (14903 and 10135), by the protected model, and every rule of the model as amended holds for it; proof.md proves that each amended entry (I3, Ncmp, I6, I4, n2, dec_msm_g1, dec_msm_g2, dec_pairings, n1, C6, C7, dec_sum_g2, H2, P1, C5, n, H3, D, ell, Bsearch, T_tr, dec_sum_g1, search_spread, msis_bound) is sound, so that the paper's theorems hold for these parameters as rules.md requires.
